chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ja'far Al-Howl, from Sallam bin Al-Mustaneer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: 'Those who have been expelled from their homes without a just cause except that they say: Our Lord is Allah.' He said: 'It was revealed regarding the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and Ali, and Hamza, and Ja'far, and it flowed regarding Al-Husayn, may Peace be upon them all.'
ai.seo_question: Who was the verse 'Those who have been expelled from their homes...' revealed for?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific asbab al-nuzul for Surah al-Hajj 22:40, identifying the Prophet, Ali, Hamza, and Ja'far as the primary addressees while extending the ruling to Al-Husayn. This linkage underscores the continuity of the Ahl al-Bayt's experience of unjust displacement, connecting the early Meccan/Medinan period with the later martyrdom of Husayn. It serves as a theological foundation for understanding the Ahl al-Bayt's status as the quintessential exemplars of steadfastness in exile.
